topic: Name the type of cell division that produces sperm and egg cells
core_question: What type of cell division produces gametes (sperm and egg cells) in humans? (secondary: Who holds the MLB record for most home runs hit in a single season?)
answer_summary: Meiosis, the type of cell division that produces gametes with half the normal chromosome number.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Barry Bonds, who hit 73 home runs in 2001, as the MLB single-season home run record holder.
